title: Maximal Inequalities for Separately Exchangeable Empirical Processes
abstract: This paper derives new maximal inequalities for empirical processes associated with separately exchangeable random arrays. For fixed index dimension $K\ge 1$, we establish a global maximal inequality bounding the $q$-th moment ($q\in[1,\infty)$) of the supremum of these processes. We also obtain a refined local maximal inequality controlling the first absolute moment of the supremum. Both results are proved for a general pointwise measurable function class. Our approach uses a new technique partitioning the index set into transversal groups, decoupling dependencies and enabling more sophisticated higher moment bounds.
